scenes.headline: Federated Robot Learning: Enabled by Argon
scenes.sub: Robots that learn from their own failures.
scenes.say: Robots usually learn from demonstrations. Hindsight teaches them from their failures, indoors and outdoors, with Gemini 4 Argon.

scenes.headline: Argon finds real failures in fleet video.
scenes.stat: 130 candidates · 44 confirmed by Argon · 15 of 15 correct on human review
scenes.say: Argon scans raw fleet video and confirms only failures it can see. A barstool. A dog. Another robot. A garden edge. Fifteen out of fifteen checked by a human were right.

scenes.headline: A digital twin that fails the same way.
scenes.say: It diagnoses each failure and rebuilds it as a physics twin that must reproduce the crash. Gemini Omni makes the twin look real.

scenes.headline: RL learns. Argon catches it cheating, then approves the real fix.
scenes.quote: The robot smoothly steers left to give the obstacle a wide berth, passing with thirty centimeters of clearance, and realigns without oscillation, stalling, or collision.
scenes.say: Reinforcement learning retrains on forty variants. Argon catches the robot gaming the reward, rewrites it, and only approves the fix that steers around the leg, every time.

scenes.headline: Federated robot learning.
scenes.bigcap: less data: only what changes the policy is uploaded
scenes.say: Robots upload only what changes the policy: not hours of video, just kilobytes. And Argon approves every update.

scenes.headline: What would not be possible without Argon.
scenes.say: For robotics teams, every field failure becomes a test and a verified fix. One model that sees, reasons about physics, writes the code, and knows when not to ship. That's Hindsight.
